documents.text: Annual review with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Their sales director said there is no room on price this year: head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. He was open on payment terms and call-off flexibility.

persona.summary: Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH, group-owned converter maker (2,200 staff); we are 0.28 % of its turnover. Head office froze all price reductions until December 2027, yet in the arena it asked +6.2 % (412.74 to 438.21). It gives about 1.2-1.4 % for 90-day payment plus a 24-36 month contract, then holds flat. Contract ends 2026-12-31 and it wants volumes. Trade terms (contract length, firm volume, 30-day payment); expect little price.
persona.notes: Wants planning security: long contract and firm volume. Contradiction: it 'froze price reductions' but asks increases, so the freeze is one-way. It also gave a price cut for keeping 30-day payment. OTD fell to 84.6 % against a 95 % target. sup:70540 is qualified for this part but also freezes prices and quotes 84-day lead times.

evidence.quote: head office has frozen all price reductions until December 2027.
Prices as per current list; discounts not possible this year (head-office directive).
the freeze on price reductions remains strictly in place.
price changes above 2 % need the approval of their pricing committee, which meets every two weeks.

avoid: repeating price arguments against the freeze
changing terms after a final offer
tactics: Open deep at the current 412.74; the freeze blocks cuts, not our refusal of an increase.
Offer a 36-month contract early; it moved to 432.15 for 36 months vs 432.94 for 24.
Offer a higher binding volume; it said a lower price needs more volume.
Test keeping 30-day payment: it offered a cut 'by maintaining our standard 30-day payment terms'.
Move something each round; it held flat for 5 rounds and sent a final offer in round 6.
playbook.expected_concession: From 438.21 it drops to about 432 in round 1 when given 90 days plus a 24-36 month contract, then holds flat; best arena score 0.923 (4 deals in 4 sessions).
